subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw preserve a legacy `plugins.slots.memory` selection through an explicit upgrade migration before the new runtime takes effect, or intentionally require all existing users to perform a manual Doctor recovery?
rationale: This is a public configuration and plugin-routing contract choice affecting existing installations; the repository policy requires canonical runtime configuration but does not make a silent change of a stored provider selection safe.

options.title: Add a guided upgrade migration
options.body: Migrate legacy memory selections to `memory.recall` before canonical routing, with clear diagnostics and upgrade coverage for existing configurations.

options.title: Require explicit Doctor migration
options.body: Keep the legacy key ignored at runtime, but make the resulting upgrade block and recovery path intentionally supported and visible to affected operators.

options.title: Narrow the initial scope
options.body: Land only the canonical recall migration and defer non-recall role slots until their plugin contracts and upgrade semantics are separately approved.

recommendation.title: Add a guided upgrade migration
recommendation.body: Migrate legacy memory selections to `memory.recall` before canonical routing, with clear diagnostics and upgrade coverage for existing configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR author explicitly requested direction from this person on the architectural shape; this is only a low-confidence routing signal pending history inspection.
